name: Amagumo Kuroe
source:
[url=/c167744]Hajime[/url]'s bodyguard who he hired because he got annoyed by a certain conspiracy theorist around him telling him that he won't survive for long. She always laughs in a creepy "ihihihi" way. Kuroe is an extremely gloomy girl who constantly wants to die and wouldn't even mind dying for the sake of others, whether it be her acting as a human shield or through other ways. At the same time, she is quite rational in comparison to the others around her.

Apparently, she started being a bodyguard because she's good at investigating things... and because her nipples are very sensitive. Her defenseless-looking sexy body, combined with her extremely low self-esteem, is constantly making Hajime horny when he glances at her, standing next to him.
